post.text:
The Greens are calling on the Govt to ensure emergency housing is available to all people experiencing homelessness as Cyclone Vaianu approaches the North Island. 

Luxon is telling people to stock up & prepare to stick out this storm at home. What does that mean for the people he has made homeless?

source.agency_name: Green Party of Aotearoa New Zealand
